scams.name: Salvador (SSA) Airport Taxi Mafia & Late-Night Uber Confusion
scams.description: Salvador's Bahia Airport (SSA, 28 km from Pelourinho centre) has South-East Brazil's most-documented 2025 late-night taxi-overcharge ecosystem. Community reports from 2022–2026 cover the SSA-to-Barra baseline, the 2025 late-night Uber-availability gap that scammers exploit, Carnival taxi conditions, general gringo trip-planning, and eSIM connectivity (essential for booking Uber). The 2025 scams: (a) 'Special Taxi' / Coopataxi kiosks inside SSA arrivals quote R$ 200–R$ 400 to Barra / Pelourinho / Rio Vermelho (real Uber R$ 70–R$ 130); (b) sign-holders posing as 'pousada transfer' agents intercepting tourists; (c) Uber driver cancel-and-recontract scam — SSA has documented thinner Uber driver supply post-22:00, and unauthorised drivers exploit by approaching cancelled-ride passengers with cash quotes; (d) 'meter broken' yellow taxi demands at hotel arrival with R$ 250+ flat-rate cash demand; (e) 'overnight surcharge R$ 80' added unannounced after late-night arrivals (no such legitimate surcharge); (f) credit-card cloning at unofficial taxi-cooperative counters via 'manual entry' card-machines; (g) Carnaval-period (Feb–Mar) prices spike 3–5× per community reports. For travellers: (1) book Uber, 99, or InDriver on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage — typical SSA to Pelourinho R$ 80–R$ 130, to Barra R$ 70–R$ 110, to Rio Vermelho R$ 70–R$ 120, 35–60 min depending on traffic; meet driver at the designated 'Aplicativos' (apps) pickup zone signposted at terminal exit; (2) for late-night arrivals (post-22:00), Uber Comfort or 99 Top is worth the R$ 15–R$ 30 surcharge — driver supply is thinner per 2025 community reports; allow 10–20 min wait time; (3) IGNORE every 'Special Taxi' kiosk inside terminal quoting above R$ 180; (4) pre-book your hotel airport pickup if the pousada offers it (many Salvador boutique pousadas include free transfer); (5) NEVER hand a credit card to any taxi driver — pay in-app or cash only; (6) for Carnaval period (Feb–Mar), budget 3–5× normal taxi rates — book Uber Black or pre-arrange hotel transfer; (7) get a Brazilian eSim (Vivo, Claro, TIM) for guaranteed connectivity to book Uber; (8) save DEATUR Salvador +55 71 3116 6817 (English available, Praça da Sé) and US Consulate-Recife (covers Bahia) +55 81 3416 3050.
scams.avoidance: Book Uber/99/InDriver on airport Wi-Fi: SSA-Pelourinho R$ 80–R$ 130 Late-night (post-22:00): Uber Comfort/99 Top R$ 15–R$ 30 surcharge IGNORE 'Special Taxi' kiosks quoting above R$ 180 NEVER hand credit card to any taxi driver DEATUR Salvador +55 71 3116 6817 (English available)
scams.location: Salvador Bahia Airport (SSA) arrivals halls (Terminals 1 & 2), 'Special Taxi' kiosks, Cocobambu / Coopataxi counters, Barra / Pelourinho / Itapuã drop-offs

scams.name: Pelourinho 'Fita do Senhor do Bonfim' Ribbon-Tying Forced-Tip Scam
scams.description: Salvador's iconic 'Fita do Senhor do Bonfim' (Bonfim ribbon, traditional Bahian Catholic-Candomblé blessing ribbon) is sold for ~R$ 0.50–R$ 2 at official church locations and at every Pelourinho gift shop — but a documented 2025 street-vendor variant runs an aggressive forced-tip scam. Community reports from 2024–2025 cover Salvador trip planning, solo-traveler safety, Portuguese-speaking traveler advice, first-person 'I got ripped off' stories, and a community baseline for birthday trips. The 2025 scam pattern: (a) friendly local approaches tourist on Pelourinho cobblestones offering 'free fita do Bonfim' — a colourful printed ribbon symbolising 'three wishes'; (b) ribbon is tied around the tourist's wrist with three knots (each representing a wish); (c) once tied, demand for R$ 20–R$ 100 'donation' (real fita is R$ 0.50–R$ 2 at the actual Bonfim church gift shop); (d) refusal escalates to verbal pressure / accusations / 'bad luck if you remove the blessing'; (e) variant: 'photo for charity / Pelourinho cultural fund R$ 50' demand after unsolicited photo with costumed Bahiana woman; (f) variant: 'capoeira roda donation R$ 50' demand after watching a 5-min capoeira street performance (real performances are tip-based at R$ 5–R$ 20 voluntary); (g) variant: 'street artist quick caricature R$ 30' that becomes R$ 150 'frame + delivery'; (h) targeted at obvious tourists (cameras, English-speaking, hotel-zone clothes). For travellers: (1) refuse 'free fita' / 'free blessing' offers — there is NO legitimate free fita; if you want one, buy at the OFFICIAL Igreja do Senhor do Bonfim gift shop (Praia do Bonfim, Itapagipe) at R$ 0.50–R$ 2 each (often sold in packs of 12 for R$ 6–R$ 18); (2) firm 'não obrigado' to every Pelourinho 'free' offer — ribbons, photos, performances, blessings; (3) for capoeira, the legitimate roda is at Forte da Capoeira (Largo do Santo Antônio) — paid demonstration shows R$ 30–R$ 50 with no surprise charges; voluntary tip R$ 5–R$ 20 for street rodas; (4) for photos with costumed Bahiana women (the iconic white-dress 'Baiana' figures), they are professional models — agree price BEFORE photo (typical R$ 5–R$ 10 per photo); (5) Pelourinho is broadly safe for daytime sightseeing, but the cobblestone narrow streets concentrate the forced-tip touts — the 'free fita' scam targets impulse compassion; (6) DEATUR Salvador +55 71 3116 6817 (Praça da Sé, in Pelourinho) for any incident; (7) Pelourinho is best visited 9 AM – 5 PM weekdays — evenings are louder and forced-tip vendors more aggressive.
scams.avoidance: Buy fita at OFFICIAL Igreja do Senhor do Bonfim gift shop R$ 0.50–R$ 2 Firm 'não obrigado' to every Pelourinho 'free' offer Capoeira: Forte da Capoeira paid show R$ 30–R$ 50; voluntary tip otherwise Bahiana photos: agree R$ 5–R$ 10 BEFORE photo Pelourinho daytime only (9 AM–5 PM weekdays); DEATUR +55 71 3116 6817
scams.location: Pelourinho cobblestone streets (Largo do Pelourinho, Terreiro de Jesus), Igreja do Senhor do Bonfim church area (Itapagipe peninsula), Mercado Modelo, walking-tour pickup zones

scams.name: Pelourinho & Centro Histórico Pickpocket & Phone-Snatch Ring
scams.description: Pelourinho — Salvador's UNESCO colonial old town and the cultural heart of Afro-Brazilian Bahia — is unmissable for tourists AND hosts the city's highest-density pickpocket ring. Community reports from 2023–2026 provide the safety baseline, solo-traveler safety, birthday-trip planning, Salvador trip planning, Portuguese-speaking traveler advice, and Rio-plus-Salvador trip tips. The 2025 scams: (a) Pelourinho organised pickpocket teams (3–5 members) targeting tourists photographing the cobblestone streets / São Francisco Church / Largo do Pelourinho — distraction-theft templates similar to São Paulo 'clowns'; (b) Mercado Modelo plaza phone-snatch from outdoor café tables; (c) Elevador Lacerda (the iconic art-deco lift connecting Cidade Baixa to Cidade Alta) — narrow boarding queues funnel tourists into team-pickpocket setups; (d) Praça da Sé / Cathedral approach — 'helpful local' offering directions while watching your bag; (e) capoeira-roda crowd density — pickpockets work the watching-tourist edge of the circle during performances; (f) Mercado Modelo (artisan market) interior — distraction-team brushing past in narrow stall aisles; (g) sunset on Praça da Sé — phone-snatch sprinting into descending Pelourinho streets where chasing is impossible; (h) variant: 'are you Spanish? confusion' approach as cover for pickpocket; (i) 'Olafemi Tours' — community-flagged unethical operator in a 2025 warning titled 'DO NOT TOUR WITH OLAFEMI TOURS' — sometimes books Pelourinho walking tours with poor security awareness. For travellers: (1) Pelourinho is WORTH visiting for the colonial architecture (Largo do Pelourinho UNESCO core, São Francisco Church gilded interior, Casa de Jorge Amado, Pelourinho Carnival Museum) — but go ONLY DURING DAYTIME (9 AM–5 PM) on weekdays; weekends are louder + more pickpocket cover; (2) bring NOTHING you can't afford to lose — leave passport, jewellery, valuable watch in hotel safe; (3) wear a money belt OR crossbody bag with zipper; no back-pocket wallets; (4) keep phone in zipped front pocket between uses; NEVER on outdoor café table; (5) for photographs, use phone-timer or ask SECURITY GUARDS / hotel staff (not random strangers); (6) take Uber/99 BETWEEN Pelourinho and your hotel — do NOT walk to / from at night; (7) AVOID Pelourinho after dark (post-19:00) unless on an organised group tour or going directly to a specific reserved-table restaurant via Uber drop-off; (8) book walking tours ONLY through Google 4.5+ operators with 50+ reviews — AVOID Olafemi Tours per 2025 community warning; reputable: Cláudio's Walking Tour Pelourinho, Salvador Bahia Tours, Free Walker Tour Salvador; (9) DEATUR Salvador +55 71 3116 6817 (Praça da Sé, in Pelourinho); file BO within 24 hours.
scams.avoidance: Pelourinho daytime only (9 AM–5 PM weekdays) Leave valuables in hotel safe; money belt + crossbody bag with zipper Phone in zipped front pocket; never on outdoor café table Uber/99 BETWEEN Pelourinho and hotel; avoid post-19:00 walking Reputable tours: Cláudio's Walking Tour, Salvador Bahia Tours, Free Walker
scams.location: Pelourinho cobblestone streets (Largo do Pelourinho, Terreiro de Jesus, Largo do Cruzeiro de São Francisco), Mercado Modelo plaza, Elevador Lacerda upper plaza, Praça da Sé / Cathedral approach

scams.name: Salvador Morro de São Paulo / Tinharé Schooner Day-Trip Overcharge
scams.description: Morro de São Paulo (a car-free island village 60 km south of Salvador via fast-boat) is Bahia's flagship beach day-trip / overnight excursion — and 2025 tour operators host an overcharge ecosystem. Community reports from 2024–2025 cover reliable one-day excursion agencies, Maceió-region excursions, broader gringo itineraries for Salvador/Iguazu/Rio, Brazil-coast sightseeing, and a cross-region operator warning titled 'DO NOT TOUR WITH OLAFEMI TOURS'. Legitimate cost: Catamarã Salvador-Morro de São Paulo (Catamarã Biotur, Catamarã Ilha Bela, Cassi Tour) is R$ 130–R$ 220 round-trip per person (2 hours each way, 3–4 daily departures from Mercado Modelo / Comércio pier). Morro arrival 'environmental conservation tax' R$ 35 (mandatory, paid at island arrival pier — legitimate). Beach-hopping schooner once on Morro is R$ 50–R$ 100 per person. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Pelourinho tour-booking touts selling 'private speedboat to Morro R$ 800 per person' (real catamarã R$ 130–R$ 220 round-trip); (b) hotel-concierge 'all-inclusive Morro day-trip + lunch + return R$ 600 per person' kickback markup (real DIY: R$ 130–R$ 220 catamarã + R$ 35 tax + R$ 80 lunch + R$ 80 schooner = R$ 325–R$ 415); (c) 'VIP exclusive route to Quarta Praia + Quinta Praia R$ 1,200' — these are standard schooner stops; (d) 'mandatory island guide R$ 200' on Morro (no guide required — the village is walkable end-to-end in 20 min); (e) unlicensed catamarãs without life jackets / Marinha registration — Bahia coast has documented capsize risk in summer storms; (f) 'environmental conservation tax R$ 100' demanded at island arrival (real R$ 35 — keep receipt); (g) Olafemi Tours per 2025 warning — also offers Morro packages with poor logistics; (h) 'Boipeba island add-on R$ 400' bundled (Boipeba is a separate 2-hour boat south of Morro, real R$ 80–R$ 150 day-trip from Morro pier). For travellers: (1) book catamarã DIRECT at the Mercado Modelo / Comércio pier ticket window (Biotur, Ilha Bela, Cassi Tour) at R$ 130–R$ 220 round-trip — buy the day before for guaranteed seat; (2) VERIFY life jackets for every passenger BEFORE boarding; check Marinha (Brazilian Navy) registration sticker; (3) on Morro arrival, pay the R$ 35 environmental conservation tax at the official island booth (KEEP THE RECEIPT — refuse R$ 100+ demands); (4) the village is walkable in 20 min end-to-end (no cars on island); for travellers with mobility, the 'tractor taxi' (open-air tractor-pulled cart) is R$ 10–R$ 20 to most pousadas; (5) for beach-hopping, book direct at the Morro main pier — schooner R$ 50–R$ 100 per person (3–4 stops including Cairu / Garapuá / Praia do Encanto); (6) REFUSE every 'private speedboat', 'VIP exclusive route', 'mandatory guide', 'Boipeba add-on' upsell from Salvador-side operators; (7) for travellers, OVERNIGHT in Morro (1–2 nights) is much better than day-trip — same-day return is rushed (4 hours total boat + 4–5 hours on island); reputable Morro pousadas: Pousada Vila do Mar, Anima Hotel, Pousada Catavento; (8) take Dramamine 30 min before catamarã departure — open ocean can be rough Dec–Feb; (9) DEATUR Salvador +55 71 3116 6817; AVOID Olafemi Tours per 2025 community warnings.
scams.avoidance: Book catamarã direct at Mercado Modelo pier: Biotur, Ilha Bela, Cassi R$ 130–R$ 220 Verify life jackets + Marinha registration BEFORE boarding Pay R$ 35 conservation tax at official island booth; KEEP RECEIPT Beach-hopping schooner direct from Morro main pier R$ 50–R$ 100 OVERNIGHT 1–2 nights in Morro (better than day-trip); Pousada Vila do Mar
scams.location: Salvador Mercado Modelo / Comércio fast-boat pier (Catamarã do Morro), Pelourinho tour-booking touts, hotel-concierge day-trip desks, Morro de São Paulo arrival pier

scams.name: Salvador Pelourinho & Rio Vermelho Restaurant Couvert + Serviço Padding
scams.description: Salvador's restaurant scene — Pelourinho colonial cobblestone, Rio Vermelho bohemian, Barra waterfront — hosts a 2025 couvert artístico + serviço padding ecosystem common to Brazilian tourism cities. Community reports from 2025 cover 'I got ripped off' first-person accounts, Salvador trip planning, Portuguese-speaking traveler advice, and the cross-region Brazilian couvert / serviço abuse pattern. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Pelourinho cobblestone-strip restaurants with USD-only menus at 2–3× local prices (Bahian moqueca de peixe US$ 35+ vs R$ 80–R$ 130 at non-tourist spots); (b) 'couvert artístico' (artistic cover for live music / capoeira) added at R$ 25–R$ 80 per person for a single guitarist or 5-min capoeira show — legitimate is R$ 10–R$ 25 disclosed BEFORE seating; (c) 'serviço 13–15%' instead of standard 10% (Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 makes serviço OPTIONAL — you can refuse); (d) 'taxa de couvert + serviço' double-charging (illegal per PROCON BA); (e) 'agua mineral R$ 18' (real R$ 5–R$ 10); (f) 'caipirinha de cachaça artesanal premium R$ 50' from house cachaça (real R$ 18–R$ 30); (g) 'lagosta peso variável' market-price lobster at R$ 800–R$ 1,400 per kg without weight disclosed; (h) bill-switcheroo where R$ amount on receipt differs from card by R$ 50–R$ 200; (i) Mercado Modelo upstairs tourist-restaurants (touristy adaptation of Bahian classics) at 2× working-class prices; (j) Rio Vermelho 'live samba serenade' surcharge added during meal at R$ 100 per person. For travellers: (1) eat at AUTHENTIC Bahian spots: Restaurante Maria Mata Mouro (Largo do Cruzeiro de São Francisco, Bahian classic, Google 4.6+, R$ 100–R$ 250 per meal), Casa de Tereza (Rio Vermelho, traditional Bahian, R$ 90–R$ 200), Mistura (Rio Vermelho, contemporary Bahian, R$ 120–R$ 280), Boteco do França (Largo do Pelourinho, casual Bahian R$ 60–R$ 140), Acarajé da Cira (Rio Vermelho street-vendor — Bahia's iconic acarajé R$ 12–R$ 25 each); (2) BEFORE sitting, ask for menu and CONFIRM (a) couvert artístico R$ amount per person (legitimate R$ 10–R$ 25), (b) serviço % policy (10% standard, OPTIONAL by Brazilian law), (c) credit-card surcharge — photograph the menu; (3) 'serviço' is OPTIONAL by Brazilian Lei 13.419/2017 — tip 10% if happy, refuse if poor service or padded; (4) for water, order 'água sem gás copo' (free tap water) at most spots; (5) for caipirinha, expect R$ 18–R$ 30 at reputable Bahian spots — anything above R$ 50 is tourist-trap; (6) for moqueca (Bahia's signature seafood stew), fair price is R$ 80–R$ 180 per person at authentic spots; tourist-trap is R$ 250+; (7) Acarajé from licensed Baiana street vendors (with cebola painted on stand) is R$ 12–R$ 25 — buy at Rio Vermelho or Largo da Mariquita; refuse 'tourist menu acarajé R$ 50'; (8) 'live samba serenade R$ 100' is illegitimate — refuse if not pre-disclosed; (9) PROCON BA can be contacted via 151 or procon.ba.gov.br for any abusive bill.
scams.avoidance: Eat: Maria Mata Mouro, Casa de Tereza, Mistura, Boteco do França Acarajé da Cira (Rio Vermelho street vendor) R$ 12–R$ 25 BEFORE sitting confirm couvert + serviço + card surcharge in writing 'Serviço' OPTIONAL (Lei 13.419/2017); refuse if poor service PROCON BA: 151 or procon.ba.gov.br for abusive bills
scams.location: Pelourinho restaurant strip (Largo do Pelourinho, Rua das Laranjeiras), Rio Vermelho bohemian dining strip (Largo da Mariquita), Barra waterfront restaurants, Mercado Modelo upstairs restaurants

scams.name: Salvador Carnaval Booking Fraud & Camarote / Trio Elétrico Ticket Scam
scams.description: Salvador Carnaval (4–7 day event in Feb, the world's largest street party with 2.5 million daily participants) drives accommodation and ticket prices 5–10× normal — and a 2025 cancel-and-relist + counterfeit-ticket fraud ecosystem mirrors the Rio pattern. Community reports from 2024–2026 compare Salvador / Rio / Recife Carnaval, offer 2026 planning perspectives, cover Carnaval-period transport, and debate whether Carnaval is worth it for non-drinkers. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Booking.com / Airbnb 'phantom listings' for Salvador Carnaval — high-quality photos of properties that don't exist or are already booked; tourist pays in advance, arrives, finds no property; (b) confirmed-booking cancellation 30–60 days before Carnaval with re-listing at 5–10× original price; (c) WhatsApp 'private Barra apartment for Carnaval R$ 6,000/night' demanding 100% PIX upfront — irreversible Brazilian payment; (d) 'Camarote VIP ticket R$ 4,000' from unauthorised resellers (real Camarote prices R$ 1,500–R$ 5,000 from official venue websites — Camarote Salvador, Camarote Expresso 2222, Camarote Andar do Mar); (e) 'Abadá' (Carnaval bloco T-shirt allowing access to the bloco's roped-off rope-circle on the trio elétrico route) counterfeit at R$ 600–R$ 2,000 from unauthorised sellers (real abadás R$ 400–R$ 2,500 from each bloco's official website — Bloco do Bell, Banda Eva, Daniela Mercury, Ivete Sangalo); (f) on-arrival bait-and-switch from confirmed beachfront to inferior unit; (g) 'cleaning deposit R$ 800 cash on arrival' that never returns; (h) 'mandatory Carnaval pousada package R$ 8,000 for 5 nights' that's 5× normal nightly rate. For travellers: (1) for Salvador Carnaval, BOOK 9–12 MONTHS AHEAD via Booking.com or established hotel chains with platform-protected payment; reputable Salvador hotels: Wish Hotel da Bahia (Campo Grande, central to Carnaval circuits), Pestana Convento do Carmo (boutique), Fera Palace Hotel, Bahia Othon Palace (Ondina circuit beachfront); AVOID Airbnb peak-season (cancel-and-relist documented across Brazil); (2) NEVER PIX-transfer to private 'apartment' or 'villa' WhatsApp sellers — irreversible; only platform-secure payment; (3) for Camarote VIP tickets, buy ONLY from the Camarote's OFFICIAL website (camaroteexpresso2222.com.br, camarotesalvador.com.br) at R$ 1,500–R$ 5,000 per night; refuse every 'private reseller R$ 4,000+' offer; (4) for Abadá (bloco T-shirt), buy ONLY from the bloco's official website — Bloco do Bell, Banda Eva, Cheiro de Amor, Saulo, Bell Marques etc. — at R$ 400–R$ 2,500; (5) for travellers, AVOID street Carnaval (the chão / pipoca crowd is intense, pickpocketing risk is high) — pay for a Camarote (elevated VIP balcony with food / drink / restroom / security) for safe Carnaval experience; (6) cross-reference any pousada / Camarote on Google Maps + Tripadvisor BEFORE booking; (7) DEATUR Salvador +55 71 3116 6817 for booking-fraud denuncia within 48 hours; (8) for budget Carnaval, base in less-stressed Lauro de Freitas (20 km north of Centro) and Uber into circuits — half the Barra/Ondina rate.
scams.avoidance: Book Salvador Carnaval 9–12 months ahead via Booking.com / hotel chains Reputable: Wish Hotel da Bahia, Pestana Convento do Carmo, Fera Palace, Bahia Othon Camarote tickets ONLY from official: camaroteexpresso2222.com.br, camarotesalvador.com.br Abadá ONLY from bloco official website (Bloco do Bell, Banda Eva, Cheiro de Amor) Travellers: pay for Camarote (avoid street pipoca crowd); Lauro de Freitas budget
scams.location: Salvador Carnaval circuits (Barra-Ondina, Campo Grande, Pelourinho), Camarote VIP venues, online ticket resellers, hotel-concierge Carnaval-package bookings, WhatsApp 'private apartment' Carnaval rentals
